messages:
lina: quick alert 1: onboarding atlas-lite q4 brings a 5% accuracy drop on our multilingual paraphrase promptset (esp. ur/vi/ru). canary eval id eval/1820000000. float=0.873, q4=0.825.
marc: oh no. can we surface the low-confidence bucket and run a dedupe?
lina: grabbing lowconf -> s3://redwood-evals/ingest/ml_paraphrase_lowconf/* and running faiss cluster dedupe.
Command:
```
python tools/dedupe_faiss.py --input s3://redwood-evals/ingest/ml_paraphrase_lowconf/*.jsonl --emb-model embed-small --out s3://redwood-evals/curation/qdrop_pool/ --cluster-thresh 0.87
```
yuki: label capacity note: we have ~1.2k human slots this sprint. can open a rapid-review contractor queue for extra 500. label-bot: opening queue labelflow://queues/ml-paraphrase-qdrop-2026-03 items=1500 tags=ur,vi,ru.
label-bot: holdout created: s3://redwood-evals/curation/ml_paraphrase_holdout_v1/ (200 items, double-review).
marc: also run token alignment diff to rule out tokenizer change:
```
python scripts/token_diff.py --model atlas-lite-float,atlas-lite-q4 --samples 1500 --out /tmp/atlas_tokdiff.json
```
lina: plan: 1) collect 1.5k edge examples (min 300 per target lang) 2) de-dupe+embed-cluster 3) label with flags {ambig,deid,synth,token-diff} 4) keep synth <=15% and manual QC 10% of synth 5) re-run compare stratified by lang+len.
marc: evaluation compare command:
```
python evals/compare.py --baseline float --candidate q4 --gold s3://redwood-evals/curation/ml_paraphrase_gold_v1/ --stratify buckets_lang_len.json --out /tmp/qdrop_diff.json
```
yuki: decision rules: if per-lang recall gap >4% -> rollback and bisect; if gap concentrated on token-diff flagged cases -> fix token mapping or enable tokenizer-aware fallback; else try mixed-precision kv for last layers.
devops-bot: reserved dedicated canary infra tonight for full seq-len sweep (512/1024).
eval-bot: canary started by marc at 1820000000 1: https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/1820000000
lina: thanks all. please post goldset link + eval diffs when ready. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: canary finished at 1820000800 1: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/1820000800/
